note: What You Can Expect as picture cards (James, 24 Nov 2026). One entry per stay: experiences and features, each a name, one line and a photograph. Names and lines come only from the stay's own filed experiences and features text. photo is the last part of a filed photograph's address (as in photo-notes.json) or null; null prints the 'Image coming soon' panel so the missing photograph is seen. also is one closing line for things with no picture. A stay with no entry keeps the earlier layout.
